boundary.architecture_scope: Observed dpkg/update-alternatives behavior is published for amd64 and arm64; common behavior is stored once with exact arm64 differences.

invocation_clock.log_clock: local CLOCK_REALTIME with one-second precision, asserted inside each subprocess invocation window and normalized in canonical output
invocation_clock.unstable_filesystem_timestamps: classified by operation rather than compared as fixed epoch values

native_requirements: Keep the current alternatives archive-member and installed-state guards fail-closed until a reviewed native contract revision is admitted.

Model update-alternatives records byte-for-byte, including auto/manual mode, ordered slave names and links, ordered candidates, signed priorities, blank-line terminators, mode 0644, root ownership, and temporary-record rename behavior.
Publish the master link and every slave as a coordinated group while preserving the observed non-atomic failure states between database, selector, and generic-link updates.
Reproduce missing-target pruning, equal-priority tie selection, manual-mode persistence, provider replacement, group deletion, and broken-link behavior without consulting ambient host alternatives.

Treat maintainer-script calls as external side effects ordered against dpkg status/info updates; preserve them across script failure and interruption exactly where dpkg does not compensate, and only unwind them when a maintainer script explicitly performs the inverse update.
Retain opaque package .alternatives members with exact bytes, modes, ownership, replacement, removal, purge, failure, and recovery visibility even though direct dpkg 1.22.22 does not interpret them.
Reject malformed, oversized, non-regular, traversing, absolute-escape, symlink-mediated, and cyclic state before native mutation, with bounded diagnostics and no host namespace access.
Bind native execution to reviewed dpkg/update-alternatives versions, architecture-specific executable digests, package/archive identities, invocation evidence, and bounded repository-local roots.
Preserve the reviewed native amd64 and arm64 execution evidence, exact architecture-specific differences, version and digest pins, and fail-closed publication checks when revising this contract.
